newsitem.title: USA: U.S. CASH SOYMEAL-SOME BASIS OFFERS FALL ON DEMAND.
newsitem.headline: U.S. CASH SOYMEAL-SOME BASIS OFFERS FALL ON DEMAND.

text.p: Some soymeal basis offers in rail and truck markets were lower Wednesday as end-users wait to see if prices will drop if rain falls in the U.S. Midwest this weekend, dealers said.
"People are pretty much covered for the nearby and people are just waiting to see if we get rain this weekend to knock the board (CBOT) down," said one crusher in the southeast.
U.S. weather forecasters were divided over the amount of rain expected to fall in overly dry areas of the Midwest.
A good, soaking rain this weekend with widespread coverage in crop areas would likely cause CBOT prices to tumble.
One dealer in the western Corn Belt said demand for meal was solid, but basis was falling because the current rate of crush caused supply to temporarily outweigh demand.
Some basis bids in northeastern rail markets were lower because low truck freight has made trucking meal rather than shipping it by rail a more attractive option for some, dealers said.
